name: crash-consistency
description: A full follower S is killed with SIGKILL 3-5 times at random points while it applies a burst of blocks from the miner M (each burst after a partition or after S was down), restarted from its own disk each time, then settled: S must match the untouched follower R and M by best full block id and UTXO state root at an equal height, answer REST, and log no unrecoverable error. All nodes run this role's jar. Applies to crash-recovery changes such as ergoplatform/ergo#2675, #2541, #2523, #2548.
